blocks.content: The **Sync API** isn't available for org-to-org Apex callouts due to Salesforce's cross-org callout restrictions — use the **Batch API** instead. If synchronous execution is required, route the call through a proxy web service hosted outside Salesforce that relays the request and response to the DSP hosting service.
